description.zh: AI-Zen 宿主的终端客户端：连本机或远端的 @ai-zen/agents-host，交互界面与纯 stdio 两条路；讲清命令、配置中心、界面要素与跟宿主的关系
description.en: The terminal client for an AI-Zen host: connects to a local or remote @ai-zen/agents-host over one WebSocket, with an interactive interface and a pure stdio path; covers the commands, the configuration centre, the interface, and the relationship with the host
